pages.text: Right-click a maid to copy her ragdoll ID to the clipboard. That ID is what data packs and resource packs use to give a model its ragdoll.
The Ragdollable Maid Spawn Egg spawns a maid that can be ragdolled right away. The Wine Fox Spawn Eggs spawn the Wine Fox maid, when that model pack is installed.

Keybinds are $(k:key.sablemaidragdoll.open_emoji) for the emote wheel and $(k:key.sablemaidragdoll.aim_cannon) for aiming a cannon.$(br2)Operators also get the /sable_maid_ragdoll command, which can spawn test maids, boxes, ragdolls and garage kits of any installed model.
